entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, Sarah. I... I hope you can help. I need to return an item, and I'm just so worried I've left it too long.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and the order number?
Yes, it's Alex Chen, order number VF77819. It's for the Urban Commuter Helmet. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, I just... things have been tough lately.
Thank you, Alex. I see the order here. Before we go further, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, no, nothing is wrong with it! It's a preference thing. My partner bought it for me, but the color... it just wasn't me. And with money being so tight, I was hoping to get a refund. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it.
I understand completely. Getting the right gear is important, both for style and for safety. Let me just check the purchase date against our policy for you. One moment.
Oh, thank you. I really needed this money back. I'd feel so guilty if we were just out the cost of a brand new helmet.

Okay, Alex, I've checked the timeline. I see the helmet was delivered 79 days ago. According to our policy for standard items, you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. So, yes, we can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Really? Oh, that is such a massive relief! Thank you, Sarah! I was so stressed about this. You have no idea.

Of course. I'm happy I could help. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email on file now. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office. Since the box is unopened, it should be a very simple process.
That's perfect. This is so much easier than I thought it would be. Thank you again for being so understanding.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been wonderful. Have a great day!
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and ride safe.
